ModMetaData.name: SloppyMods Mending Solutions
ModMetaData.author: SloppyMod
ModMetaData.description: Repair damaged apparel and weapons at a hand mending station, an electrical mending station, or a fully automated industrial repair center at higher tech. Material cost, work time, waste and the risk of a botched repair all scale with how damaged the item is and how skilled the mender is. Requires Biotech and Vanilla Recycling Expanded: repair work always produces real waste byproducts (Wastepacks and recyclable trash) as a core mechanic, not an optional extra.
